description:
Navy Federal Credit Union currently does not provide sponsorship for this role. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship. 
  
 To research, evaluate, design, implement, and maintain system and product solutions, applying knowledge of engineering principles. To provide technical direction and engineering support for projects and infrastructure. Develop and maintain expert functional knowledge of evolving IT engineering industry technologies/competition, concepts and trends.

 Oracle RAC Database administration on AIX Unix platform: Perform install, setup, configuration, performance tuning and operational support for high availability Oracle Real Applications Clusters (RAC) running on IBM AIX operating systems.
 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI): Provision, migrate, optimize, and support enterprise Oracle databases on OCI platform.
 Security Implementation: Enforce advanced security controls and network encryption to TLS 1.2 standard for client-to-database and server communication.
 Automated Patching: Execute quarterly Critical Patch Updates (CPU) across database environments using Oracle Fleet Maintenance tools and OEM automation.
 Disaster Recovery: Build, maintain, and test Oracle Data Guard physical standby setups for High availability, zero data loss, and swift failovers.
 Infrastructure operations Automation: Automate routine database management, provisioning, backup monitoring, and health checks using automation scripting (Ansible/Shell)
 Enterprise Operations and Monitoring: Utilize OEM for proactive system monitoring, diagnostics, and performance management.
 IT Service Management: Manage incidents and change tickets using ServiceNow, perform root cause analysis for incidents. Prompt response to 24/7 on-call notification for participation in major incident bridges or critical database system alerts
 Apply engineering principles into the design and enhancement of new and existing systems
 Document new system components, or modifications to existing components
 Ensure the security and integrity of system and product solutions including compliance with Navy Federal, industry engineering and Information Security principles and practices
 Perform engineering tasks and assignments in support of business needs
 Perform engineering technology research, procurement, deployment, and configuration for new and modified systems
 Provide technical leadership in the architecture discipline and development of information technology solutions
 Present clear, organized, and concise information to all audiences through a variety of media to enable effective business decisions
 Installation, Upgrade, and Migration of Oracle RAC databases
 Performance Tuning for Production Oracle databases
 Design and implementation of High Availability solutions with Oracle RAC and Dataguard
 Apply Oracle Quarterly Security Patches patch releases to databases to maintain security compliance
 24/7 on-call DBA rotation for supporting production environment for Oracle DB Team
 Perform other duties as assigned
 
 2-5 years of Oracle Database Administrator experience with a proven track record with Oracle RAC database administration on AIX platform.
 Cloud Experience: Hands-on experience creating and supporting database deployments in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or similar
 Experience in implementation and supporting Oracle Multi-tenant Architecture databases
 Advanced automation scripting experience
 Significant experience with Oracle EM and Oracle Fleet Maintenance
 Advanced knowledge of engineering discipline
 Advanced organizational, planning, and time management skills
 Advanced skill exercising initiative and using good judgment to make sound decisions
 Database and presentation software skills
 Research, analytical, and problem solving skills
 Expert verbal and written communication skills
 Word processing and spreadsheet software skills
 Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Information Technology or the equivalent combination of training, education, and experience
  
 Additional Information 
 Hours: 
 Monday - Friday, 8:00AM - 4:30PM (Rotating on-call schedule required)
  
 Locations: 
 820 Follin Lane, Vienna, VA 22180
 141 Security Drive Winchester, VA 22602
